definitions.full: H4926. mishma I. [ מִשְׁמָע ] noun [masculine] thing heard ; — construct אָוְנָיו לאלְֿמַשְׁמַע Isa 11:3 not according to what his ears hear , not superficially (|| עֵינָיו לְֹמַרְאֵה ).
